task.title: Lift Truck Parking
task.shortdesc: When leaving the operator station, park the lift truck in authorised areas only. Do not

context.p: When leaving the operator station, park the lift truck in authorised areas only. Do not block traffic.

ul.li: Park the lift truck level, with the forks lowered and the mast tilted forward until the fork tips touch the floor.
Move the direction control lever to NEUTRAL.
Turn the key switch off and remove the key.
Turn the disconnect switch to OFF(if equipped).
Do operate the disconnecting switch after 30 seconds from start key-off. Otherwise Engine Control Unit (ECU) can be damaged.
Block the drive wheels when parking on an incline.
